errors.evidence: The description misspells the category label "Ниско EGDI" as "Нисско EGDI".
The legend is located at the bottom center of the chart, not at the bottom right ("долу вдясно").

errors.text_span: Няма допълнително групиране или наслагване на стълбите.
errors.evidence: This statement is inaccurate and misleading. The chart is a grouped bar chart, where bars are grouped by EGDI category on the x-axis. The statement "Няма допълнително групиране" (There is no additional grouping) wrongly denies this primary structural feature.
The values for the years 2016 and 2018 in the "Ниско EGDI" category are swapped. The chart shows a value of 32 for 2016 and 16 for 2018, whereas the description states 16 for 2016 and 32 for 2018.

errors.text_span: Няма определен ред на подреждане на стълбите освен този на годините.
errors.evidence: This is incorrect. The main groups of bars on the x-axis are ordered by the increasing level of the EGDI index, from "Ниско" to "Много високо".
